headline: Acerinox Q3 EBITDA Beats Consensus Estimates by 8%
summary: Spanish stainless steel manufacturer Acerinox posted third-quarter EBITDA that surpassed market expectations by 8%.
why: Acerinox is a leading global producer of stainless steel and high-performance alloys, sensitive to European industrial demand and nickel prices.

impacts.name: Acerinox SA
impacts.why: Third-quarter operating profit exceeded market forecasts by 8%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: An 8% EBITDA beat against consensus estimates supports higher valuations and immediate buying interest in Acerinox shares.
